notices.trigger: Home solicitation sale: a consumer credit sale (including a sale paid by credit card or by a consumer loan whose lender is subject to claims from the sale) solicited and signed at the residence; a cash or check job with no credit is outside the article and the federal rule governs it
notices.format: Under the conspicuous caption BUYER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL; no point size, bold, placement or detachable form rule; the federal notice may be printed instead
notices.support: A cash or check job with no credit is outside the article; the federal rule governs it.
notices.summary_row: Right to cancel, BUYER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL statement, refund, services, FTC option
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole section 37-2-503, with rules about the written agreement, the copy to the buyer and late cancellation around the statement, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract; the statement itself needs to be cut out by hand. Also it applies only to credit sales, which the builder cannot tell.

changes.new: Three business days; credit sales only (a credit card or lender-financed sale counts); printing the federal notice satisfies South Carolina
changes.support: A cash or check job with no credit is outside the article; the federal rule governs it.

changes.new: Home solicitation credit sales (including sales paid by credit card or by a consumer loan with claims against the lender) solicited and signed at the residence; a cash or check job is governed by the federal rule only
changes.support: A cash or check job with no credit is outside the article; the federal rule governs it.

changes.new: Until midnight of the third business day after the buyer signs an agreement that complies with the state article.
changes.support: until midnight of the third business day after the day on which the buyer signs an agreement or offer to purchase which complies with this part

changes.new: Residential Builders Commission license (ch. 59): residential builder when the job costs more than $5,000, residential specialty contractor when more than $500; Contractor's Licensing Board (ch. 11) over $10,000; the Commission is the exclusive licensor for residential-only work
changes.support: The commission is the exclusive licensing and registration entity for persons who engage solely in residential building and in residential specialty contracting.

unsure: SC-cancel: the statute allows the federal notice instead of the South Carolina statement, so the owner may prefer to print only the federal notice; and it applies only to credit sales, which the builder cannot detect.
SC arbitration notice (15-48-10): underlined capitals on the first page of the contract, but no wording is prescribed, so I did not add a notice for it.
